shared_elements: human figure(s) rendered in relief on stone
carved relief with low-relief bodily details
circular/disc motifs (rosettes in A, circular carvings on B's back)
justification: Both depict human forms in relief and both include circular/disc motifs (rosette bands in A, ring-like carvings on the back of B), but that is a generic coincidence. A is a narrative processional frieze of profile figures leading a camel between ornamental borders, whereas B is a single monumental frontal figure with a massive head and shallow symbolic carvings on its back, sharing neither composition nor relationships between elements.
